title: XSS vulnerability via unescaped message in crossSellBanner
reasoning: The message content is rendered directly into JSX without escaping. While React escapes text by default when using {variable}, if the config contains JSX or is preprocessed in an unsafe way upstream, this could be exploited. More critically, if config sources allow rich text or are populated from external CMS/APIs marked with 'user-input' trust boundary, this is a vector.
reproduction: If config pipeline allows HTML or JSX injection: set config.crossSell.message to include malicious content. If the config is processed as JSX or dangerouslySetInnerHTML is used anywhere in the chain, XSS occurs.
recommendation: Explicitly treat message as untrusted plain text. If rich formatting is needed, use a safe markdown/sanitization library. Document that config.crossSell.message must be plain text only. Add runtime type validation.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests exist. No input sanitization or type guards are present to enforce plain text constraint.
suggestedRegressionTest: Unit test: verify that message containing <script> tags or other HTML is rendered as escaped text, not executed. Config validation test: reject configs with HTML in message field.
minimumFixScope: src/src/portal/modules/crossSellBanner.tsx: add explicit sanitization or validation for message field; document plain-text-only constraint
